lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots, spaced approximately equidistantly in horizontal rows and vertical columns across the visible mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are observed intersecting with horizontal rows of circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).
